truncation_analysis.root_cause: Paperclip stores errorReason truncated to 34 chars. The running npm package (v2026.722.0) has DEFAULT_MODEL='auto' (fix commit 2f5ff6345 not deployed), so all 75 hermes_local agents with empty adapterConfig resolve model='auto' → Hermes config.yaml provider=openrouter → OpenRouter returns HTTP 404 for qwen3-coder:30b → Hermes CLI crashes with Python traceback → stored as 34-char truncated string 'Traceback (most recent call last):'. Operator's 395-char error is a separate transport-level streaming failure (RemoteProtocolError). Oracle-2 has null errorReason (crash before traceback capture).
truncation_analysis.stale_errorReason_persistence: Paperclip does NOT clear errorReason on status recovery. 26+ agents across idle/running/error hold the truncated traceback string, but only 10 are actually in error status. This is why the wake comment's claim of '27 agents in error' is false — the string count is stable at 27-29 but true error status oscillates (3→0→26→27→26→3→9→10) as agents crash and recover on each heartbeat.

adapter_config_analysis.impact: Without explicit model in adapterConfig, resolution depends entirely on DEFAULT_MODEL constant. Running npm package still has DEFAULT_MODEL='auto' which resolves to OpenRouter → 404 for qwen3-coder:30b → Hermes CLI crash → 34-char truncated traceback.
